matches.note: Blake (Love's cousin) counted the pin for Love; Love then attacked Blake with a lariat after the match anyway.
Sterling escapes through the cage door for the win after Lenny is dislodged trying to climb out.

matches.stipulation: IGA World Tag Team Championship, Sledgehammer/Ladders/Chairs match
matches.note: New champions; Pimp Daddy pins Avery with the Hizoe Down onto a sledgehammer.

Andy Madison and Lara Leigh Love interfered for Madison; Tawny Blake ran in against them; the Nightstalker no-sold a superkick meant for Valley, chasing off Andy Madison. Brittney Christopher then distracted Valley at the cage door, letting Madison hit a Dragon Suplex for the pin.

matches.stipulation: UFC Octagon, special guest referee Pandemonium
matches.note: Billed as settling who ran over Drifter's tag partner Marc Powers (revealed as Davenport on the previous show). Todd Bishop lured Pandemonium away, then returned wearing a referee shirt to officiate after Pandemonium's counterpart shirt was used against Drifter; Tommy Danger ran in to cane Davenport and lock the Nightmare Sleeper, and Bishop called for the bell, awarding Drifter the win by technical knockout.
Both men were still tangled in barbed wire when referee Bull Anderson waved the match off as a draw, ruling neither fit to continue.

matches.stipulation: Boiler Room, falls count anywhere, for the vacated IGA World Heavyweight Championship (Main Event)
matches.note: Opens with Danger disguised as Irons for a mind-games angle in the boiler room. The match's second referee, billed as Erik Rockwell, was revealed mid-match as a masked Pandemonium, hitting Bull Anderson with a Fisherman Buster before being run off; the real Erik Rockwell does not appear on this card. Wheelchair-bound Dirk O'Malley, Danger's retired mentor, stood from his chair at ringside late in the match to urge Danger up. Danger wins with a high cross body for the pin, becoming the new champion.

name: Combat Zone

date.source: the card's own header and posting

note: A month-long gap separates this card from Requiem for Pain (31 October); several title changes and a Matt Allen return happened in that gap undocumented among the served cards (see individual reign and tenure corrections). A "Tournament of Warriors" bracket begins this card, seeded by qualifying matches, for a future World Title shot. Pandemonium confirms a full rebrand as "The Loki" Scott Stylez, dropping the Pandemonium name.

matches.stipulation: IGA Fight Club Championship (taped earlier, empty arena)
matches.note: Williams sealed Smoothy in a dumpster and sent it down a stairwell; no bell or formal decision is shown on the card. Treated here as a Williams win by clear implication, not an announced result.
Matt Allen (a returning, presumed-same match for the EWA-1998 record matt-allen-ewa) interfered for Scarlet at ringside but backed off before the finish.
Sets up Anderson vs. Corey Irons in the next round.
Hallowe'en Jack's manager Michael Lazlow interfered repeatedly; Jack wins with a chair-assisted All Hallows Eve on Parker.

Not a title match; Blake wanted a Women's Championship shot. Hannibal Carver interfered throughout, smashing Blake's fingers in the cage mesh with a chair; Nikita Sabine ran in for Blake, slamming the cage door on Galiver. Carver ultimately threw Galiver out the door himself to seal the win, then attacked champion Lara Leigh Love (who had run in with a chair) with a belt-assisted Shining Wizard.

matches.stipulation: IGA World Heavyweight Championship, no time limit (Main Event)
matches.note: Sean Smith appeared at ringside without interfering, baiting Danger into breaking focus twice; Lazz Sterling then drew Danger to the ropes as a decoy. A returning Patrick McGrath ("The Emerald City Kidd", the IGA Jazz Academy's head trainer, unseen since the promotion's first Combat Zone main event) speared Danger's throat with a cane to break up the Tomakazi, drawing the DQ. Danger retains.
